<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 16 % of the base peak) matches a molecule containing about 14‑15 carbons. The formula C₁₄H₁₈O₃ has a calculated exact mass of 234.1256 Da (Δ ≈ 6 mDa) and predicts an M+1 intensity consistent with ~14 carbons, fitting the observed data best. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C₁₄H₁₈O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
